title: HIGHLIGHTER BLUETOOTH SPEAKER
subtitle: Compact Portable Audio Product
shortDescription: A compact highlighter-shaped portable audio product that combines Bluetooth audio, rechargeable power, miniature speaker technology, and unconventional consumer product design in a familiar stationery-inspired form factor.
fullDescription: The Highlighter Bluetooth Speaker is a compact consumer electronics project that reimagines the familiar form of a stationery highlighter as a portable audio product. Developed as a product engineering and hardware prototyping project, it combines portable audio functionality with a distinctive everyday-object-inspired form factor, creating a product that is visually familiar while serving an entirely different purpose. The project explores how compact electronic products can be designed around unconventional physical forms without compromising practical usability. The prototype integrates Bluetooth audio, rechargeable battery operation, a miniature loudspeaker, physical controls, and compact electronic packaging within a highlighter-sized enclosure. The project also explores standalone audio playback, selectable audio modes, custom amplifier development, and future PCB miniaturization. Beyond the hardware itself, the work covers product concept development, enclosure adaptation, component integration, prototype construction, hardware evaluation, product refinement, and patent-oriented documentation. The result is a distinctive portable audio concept that demonstrates the combination of embedded hardware engineering, industrial product thinking, sustainable prototyping, and consumer-focused design.
problemStatement: Portable speakers are commonly designed as conventional electronic products with recognizable speaker-oriented shapes. This project explores an alternative product direction by using a familiar stationery-inspired form factor to create a compact and visually distinctive audio product. The goal is to combine portability, practical audio functionality, compact electronics, and unconventional product design while maintaining a simple and recognizable physical form.
solution: A compact highlighter-shaped portable audio product designed around Bluetooth audio, rechargeable power, miniature speaker integration, and space-efficient hardware packaging. The product concept provides a distinctive alternative to conventional portable speakers while creating a platform for future standalone audio playback, custom amplification, improved acoustics, and further hardware miniaturization.
